# Seed library moves its catalog to a spreadsheet

The Tamarack Seed Savers, who keep their seed library in a cabinet at the Millbrook branch, have finished moving their seed catalog from index cards to a shared spreadsheet. The catalog migration took two weekends and three volunteers.

Each packet now has a row with the variety, the year saved, the grower, and a germination rate. Volunteers found that about a fifth of the cards described packets that no longer existed, so they dropped those rows.

The group asks library staff not to edit the spreadsheet. Questions go to the seed library volunteers at their monthly swap. See also [[Migrating the birding club mailing list]], another volunteer group that moved its records this winter.
